profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Sr. Software Dev. Engineer with extensive experience in developing scalable applications.  As an IT Professional, I've managed and worked closely with the customer and client representatives from inception to completion of highly visible enterprise applications.  I have attained robust skills in developing object-oriented driven programs while applying solid analytical skills. 

Through previous opportunities from participating in collegiate sports to developing teams, I have had the ability to sharpen my soft skills by adapting to different leadership styles and techniques while working with new team members.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Partners and works with cross-functional teams to diagnose issues and enhance application performance.

•	Developed responsive, user-friendly web interfaces using React, TypeScript, and CSS.
•	Executed end-to-end data migration from legacy systems to PostgreSQL using AWS DMS, enabling improved performance and scalability.
•	Reduced data retrieval interval from 2 hours to 1 minute by creating a REST API and automating triggers with AWS EventBridge for near real-time access to mission-critical data.
•	Built and optimized AWS Lambda functions to support serverless backend microservices.
•	Applies Agile methodologies to deliver high-quality software solutions on schedule.
•	Mentors junior developers, promoting a culture of knowledge sharing and growth.
•	Conducts thorough code reviews and optimizations to improve scalability and efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Java · Java Development · react · TypeScript · AWS Lambda · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Analysis · Front-end Development · Back-End Web Development · Computer Science · Software Development · Web Development · Web Application Development

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement a new modernize web application solution for the TSA Federal Air Marshalls (FAMs) for handling staffing of mission critical flights.

- Implements responsive web designs using React, CSS, and Typescript for seamless functionality.
- Implements AWS Lambdas to leverage a serverless functionality for our backend mircoservices.
- Utilizes Agile development methodologies to deliver quality software solutions on time.
- Mentors junior developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
- Conducts code reviews and performs optimizations to enhance application performance and scalability.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Software Engineering · Front-end Development · Web Development · TypeScript · Software Development · Agile Methodologies · React.js · AWS Lambda

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Was one of the lead consultants on successfully implementing projects, aligning based on client needs for DHS USCIS and the Identity, Credential, Access, and Management (ICAM) division.

- Implemented responsive web applications using Angular that leverage role based access Java microservices via SAML and OAuth.
- Utilized Agile development methodologies to deliver quality software solutions on time.
- Mentored junior developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
- Conducted code reviews and performs optimizations to enhance application performance and scalability.
- Helped implement some continuous integration and development pipeline checks that resulted in faster deployments and improved software quality.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Java Development · Model-View-Controller (MVC)

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description:
As the Founder & CEO of Driven Konnections, LLC, I provide leadership by developing a strategic plan to help advance the company’s mission and objectives through cost-effective management of resources.  I oversee the day to day operations to ensure that the company is functioning efficiently and providing quality products and services to our clients and customers.  Additionally, I help promote revenue, profitability, and growth for the entire company.
	
•	Plan, develop, organize, implement, direct and evaluate the organization's fiscal function and performance.
•	Participate in the development of the corporation's plans and programs as a strategic partner.
•	Provide strategic financial input and leadership on decision making issues affecting the company.
•	Secure contracts, clients, and customers for future work

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
As an IT Consultant, I currently specialize in software development, enhancement, and maintenance of federal and commercial applications.  Leveraging Java and other technologies that are utilized by the Java framework, I provide experience and expertise to a development team that leverages either Waterfall or Agile methodology environment.  I analyze previous version of applications to develop a plan to improve the overall functionality, performance and user-friendliness of the application through communication with stack holders, product owners, and management.  
	
•	Analyze previous version of application to develop a plan to improve the overall functionality, performance and user-friendliness of the application.
•	Continuously learning new technology to leverage with the Java language and framework
•	Communicate with the capability and product owner to gather requirements and estimate a timeframe for completion.
•	Leverage the Spring framework to configure components utilized by the application and its lifecycle management of the objects.
•	Employs Hibernate framework to map objects to their relational object in a RBDMS.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
As part of a development team, I help design and develop the new ACE application for the U.S. Customs and Border Protection Cargo Division. Working in a Scale Agile environment, the team would complete 2 sprints of tasks that lead up to the overall goal the 3 month increment.

•	Help develop a parsing framework to read and validate the messages produced from the new ACE system.
•	Implemented AngularJS into the application so that the application will be more generic and robust.
•	Accountable for speaking with the capability and project owner to ensure the necessary requirements were being implemented during the sprints/increments.
•	Assisted with configuration efforts in deploying an internal testing tool to the UNIX box utilizing Maven.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Java Development · Model-View-Controller (MVC)

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
As part of a development team, I help design and develop the Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearm, and Explosives (ATF) new version of the firearm tracing enterprise application.  Additionally, analyze previous version of application to develop a plan to improve the overall functionality, performance and user-friendliness of the application. 

•	Utilize Oracle’s Application Development Framework (ADF), Business Components, Enterprise Java Bean (EJB) 3.0
•	Responsible for communicating with client and gathering requirements through face-to-face meetings and over the phone.
•	Document specifications and implementation procedures for new version of application
•	Collaborate with client and UI specialist to provide the end-user with a slick, user-friendly interface.
•	Work with the Database Administrator Team to ensure design and development necessary SQL queries within RDBMS.
•	Assist with the configuration and release efforts of the application to the development environment by leveraging Subversion.
•	Create and modify build scripts through Ant to automate the build process to the development, test, and IV&V environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Java Development · Model-View-Controller (MVC)

positions.title: Jr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Supported the Office of The Judge Advocate General of the U.S. Army
As a Jr. Software Developer, supported and assisted the helpdesk with tickets and code fixes, providing technical support of the different applications to clients out in the field. 
Also was lead on a minor project and part of a team on a larger project for the OTJAG.
Assisted with importing new structures into the applications.
Created and tested new applications/databases before pushing to production

positions.title: Service Desk Technician/Jr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Supported the Office of The Judge Advocate General of the U.S. Army
As a Service Desk Technician, fielded calls from the users, providing quick and easy resolutions to simple code fixes and tickets.
Daily task of being a Service Desk Technician was to answer all new tickets in a timely manner. Also, close prior tickets with a resolution for future reference.
As a Jr. Software Developer, supported and assisted the helpdesk with tickets and code fixes, providing technical support of the different applications to clients out in the field. 
Also was lead on a minor project and part of a team on a larger project for the OTJAG.
Assisted with importing new structures into the applications.
Created and tested new applications/databases before pushing to production
